headline: Models are commodities. The Harness is the product.
narration: Two coding agents using the exact same LLM can perform worlds apart. The difference is Harness Engineering.

headline: Plan, Execute, Verify, and Recover
narration: A production harness enforces strict steps: sandboxing, tool permissions, deterministic verifiers, and automatic retries on failure.

headline: Never trust an agent without a verifier
narration: Just like our Reels pipeline runs ffprobe before publishing, your harness should run tests, linters, and schema checks automatically.

headline: Final part: Graph Engineering
narration: Save this for your agent architecture, and follow DababonPro for the final part on Graph Engineering.
